output: html_document

```{r}
res <- command_block_doc_helper(dat, cdb_args_raw)
```


We use this original dataset:

```{r}
dat %>% gt()
```


... and this command block of class `"`r res$cdb_class`"`:

```{r}
cdb_args_raw %>% purrr::set_names(LETTERS[seq_len(ncol(.))]) %>% gt()
```

When we pass this command block to `parse_command_args()`, it results in the following arguments:
```{r}
res$cdb_args
```

When we apply the command block on the data, it results in this modified data:

```{r}
res$result %>% gt()
```
